action_items.text: All participants will fill out a questionnaire after the meeting.
The Designers will work on their individual presentations.
The Marketing Expert will work on their individual presentations.

decisions.text: A locator device separate from the remote will be incorporated into the design.
The locator device will operate with radio signal.
Speech recognition will not be used.
The group decided that their target marketing group would be mostly teenagers and young professionals.
There will not be a stand for the remote when it is not in use.
The group decided that the locator function eliminated the need for this component.
The locator function will not involve an LED indicator.
The remote will emit a sound when located.
The main interface will include a power button.
The main interface will include a scroll wheel function in place of a number pad.
